_doc: Revert-verify for the last live narrow-grammar copy of #4353: `PropertyNameValidator.KEY_SHAPE`. The shape decides whether a `--property` key is CHECKED at all — a key that does not match is skipped — so a shape narrower than the emitter's grammar is a fail-open hole, not a cosmetic mismatch. Axes E1 (hyphenated key of a known property passes) / E2 (hyphenated key of an UNKNOWN property is now rejected — the load-bearing one) / E3 (a Capitalised prefix is skipped, the deliberate loosening) live in packages/cli/tests/integration/create-property-name-validation.integration.test.ts alongside the 11 pre-existing axes of req 430e84f1, which act as the control for unchanged behaviour. Measured 2026-09-26: control 14/14 green. ⛤ Behaviour delta measured on all three live vaults BEFORE the change (766/506/470 property assets): exactly ONE key starts being validated (`my-tbox__Norm_recordedIn`, itself a declared property, so it passes) and ZERO stop — which is why this needed no founder call despite the issue flagging it as a behaviour change. ⛤ ONE mutant, deliberately: the change is a single expression, and M1 already reddens BOTH directions of it. A second mutant that widens the shape would redden only a prose-named pre-existing axis, which this spec's red_re cannot report — a mutant whose verdict the driver cannot show is not a measurement.

Краснеют ДВЕ оси, и они разнонаправленны — в этом и смысл пары: E2 (дефисный неизвестный ключ снова ПРОПУСКАЕТСЯ, то есть возвращается fail-open дыра) и E3 (ключ с заглавной первой буквой снова ПРОВЕРЯЕТСЯ и отвергается). E1 остаётся зелёной: под узкой формой дефисный ключ известного свойства тоже проходит — просто по другой причине (его не проверяли), и одна эта ось дефект не различает.
